descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-19 Medication Tracker · S18 「在 Medications 面板里删掉的行不会回来；删除确认一次」 A row removed in the Medications panel stays gone; the removal asks for confirmation once

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T8 A deleted medication row never comes back unless re-dictated, and each delete asks for confirmation once (no bulk delete).（TFA-94699 AC 5；TFA-94699 AC 6） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U1 The pre-round medication list and the encounter Medication Tracker are one set of rows: a row the pre-round Save Note writes shows in the Post-Round tracker and a change from Save & Extract shows on …（UAT TC-19；TFA-92597 What；TFA-92597 AC 3）

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Fresh physician with the fixture Hospital patient; pre-round Save Note seeds aspirin and pantoprazole

When Medications panel → Edit → remove pantoprazole → Save Medications; then Save & Extract 'Doing well, plan unchanged.'; then open the pre-round editor and Save Note again on the unchanged pre-round text

Then Removing asks for confirmation exactly once; pantoprazole is gone from the panel and the Post-Round tracker after the Save & Extract; aspirin untouched

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：TFA-94699 AC 5 and AC 6 (gate). Blocked: on main the Remove button (MedicationsPanel.tsx, aria-label 'Remove <drug>') drops the row from the draft with no confirmation, and the confirmation belongs to TFA-94699 (in progress), so agent-matrix.sh skips this case. When unblocked, cp1 must also show the confirmation, and every failure is filed under T8's gate. …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S18 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-19.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent；辅助：PW · Playwright 脚本 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
